title: feat(apps): pr-review-fixer agent that reviews a PR and pushes a fix branch
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Drjacky added PR Review Fixer for Quest #17245. Given a GitHub pull request link, the code agent reviews patches and head-revision files with openai/gpt-6.1-sol, then returns a verdict, file:line findings, a proposed diff, token usage and estimated Pollen cost. It loads up to 12 changed files, sends files up to 30 KB in full, and uses excerpts around hunks for larger files; the model can request more code for up to two rounds. Proposed search/replace edits apply only when their text matches exactly once. Without a GitHub token, the agent returns a diff and writes nothing; with a fork and a fine-grained token, it can create one fix commit based on the PR head on a new fork branch, without moving an existing branch. A 'nothing wrong' verdict pushes nothing. The token is removed before text reaches the model, and the agent accepts both Chat Completions and Responses requests. Its proposed fixes are not test-run by the agent.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements, never oversized or dominating the image, strictly pixel art style, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
